name: Warena
description:
About This Game

PLAY CARDS, RULE THE BATTLEFIELD

Warena is a real-time card battler. Play cards to deploy troops and buildings and cast devastating spells. Push toward the enemy's castle while keeping yours defended. Master fast thinking and tactical cardplay to claim victory!

EVERY MANA POINT IS A GAMBLE

Your mana refills in real time. Every point you spend is a point you can't use to respond. Every point you save is pressure you're not applying.

  • Flood or hold: Swarm the lanes with cheap units to force a response, or bank mana for one massive push.

  • Counter windows: Drop a spell the moment your opponent overcommits and turn their attack into your advantage.

  • Read the opponent: Spot what they're building toward and force them to burn resources before the plan comes together.

DECKBUILDING WHILE BATTLING

  • Runes: Shape your build during matches by investing in new cards and buffs. Increase your mana generation, power up your next offense, and more.

  • Hero Skills: Choose a unique ability at the start of each match to further complement your playstyle.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

  • Single-Player Campaign: Learn the mechanics and battle against increasingly difficult AI opponents as you progress through the campaign.

  • 1v1 PvP: Ranked player versus player matches when you're ready to test your reads against a real strategist. Every card is earned through play. The better player wins.

BUILT FOR COMPETITION

All cards are earned through play. Card stats are visible. Reads, mana spending, and timing decide the match.

Join us on Discord!
short_desc: Warena is a real-time card battler with tactical depth. Deploy troops, cast spells, and push toward the enemy castle as your opponent pushes back. 1v1 PvP and single-player campaign.
